SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, 
"30 days", "31-60 days", "61-90 days", "91-120 days", ">120 days" 
FROM (
    SELECT ss.s_store_name, st.s_company_id, st.s_street_number, st.s_street_name, st.s_street_type, st.s_suite_number, st.s_city, st.s_county, 
    st.s_state, st.s_zip, 
    CASE WHEN dd.diff <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "30 days", 
    CASE WHEN dd.diff > 30 AND dd.diff <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "31-60 days", 
    CASE WHEN dd.diff > 60 AND dd.diff <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "61-90 days", 
    CASE WHEN dd.diff > 90 AND dd.diff <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "91-120 days", 
    CASE WHEN dd.diff > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ">120 days"
    FROM store_sales ss JOIN (SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, MIN(sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) AS diff 
                              FROM store_returns 
                              WHERE sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN d1.d_date_sk AND (d1.d_date_sk + 120)
                              GROUP BY sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk) dd ON ss.ss_ticket_number = dd.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = dd.sr_item_sk 
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk 
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk 
) subquery 
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip 
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip 
LIMIT 100
